survivors.claim: verdict.js silently drops a previously-enforced usage refusal (--retain without --ledger used to exit 2 naming the remedy; now silently discards --retain and continues to derive a verdict word) — an undocumented, un-Decision'd behavior change to the critical-tier verdict-derivation script, with zero test coverage of either the old or new behavior.
survivors.impact: A future caller who passes --retain without --ledger, expecting the previous hard refusal that names the fix, now gets a printed verdict word with the evidence silently never retained — a caller misuse turns into silently-missing review evidence instead of an immediate, actionable error.
survivors.evidence:
node spec/scripts/verdict.js --manifest /tmp/vdtest/manifest.jsonl --retain /tmp/vdtest/retain -> prints 'UNVERIFIED', exit 1 (observed). Pre-diff code at c0113441b316a1de01a42534df0e1f876c7b88dd printed 'verdict.js: --retain requires --ledger ...' and exit 2. Diff hunk: '-  console.error(...--retain requires --ledger...)
-  process.exit(2)
+  // no ledger row means no runId to key an artifact by — skip retention and continue
+  retainDir = null'. Not referenced by any Decision, AC, File Plan row, or the plugin.json changelog paragraph for 7.49.0, nor by specs/20260901/02-run-provenance.deviations.md.
